title: HandBack
description: What an L1+ worker hands back for a human (or the trusted phase) to review.

ticket.description: The ticket key this concerns, if any.

repo.description: The repository the patch applies to (`owner/name`).

base.description: The base commit the patch was made against.

patch.description: Relative path of the patch file inside the run's output directory.

files_changed.description: Files the patch touches, as parsed from the patch text by the Kit (not as claimed by the worker).

summary.description: What the worker says it did. Untrusted prose.

next_human_step.description: The one thing a human should do next.
